name: Flat Physical Damage
description: Adds raw physical damage to strikes; reinforces armor with denser physical mass.
weaponFlavorText: Pure brute force without apology. Your blade becomes heavier, sharper, more devastating. This is the foundation of damage in its most honest form.
armorFlavorText: You're built different. Denser muscle, thicker bone, heavier frame. Taking hits becomes a matter of sheer physical mass. Enemies swing, you absorb, they regret.

name: Fire Damage
description: Adds flat fire elemental damage to strikes; grants fire resistance on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Adds flat fire elemental damage to every strike. No burning, no DoT, no secondary effect -- just raw heat applied directly to whoever you're hitting. The burn fantasy lives in the Ignite compound. This is the foundation.
armorFlavorText: Adds fire resistance. Enemy fire spells and flame attacks deal less damage. You don't become fireproof, but you stop being kindling.

name: Cold Damage
description: Adds flat cold elemental damage to strikes; grants cold resistance on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Adds flat cold elemental damage to every attack. No slow, no freeze on its own -- just biting cold damage. The slowing fantasy lives in the Frostbite compound. This is the ingredient, not the meal.
armorFlavorText: Adds cold resistance. Enemies wielding frost magic will find their spells hitting softer. You're not immune -- you're just harder to ice.

name: Lightning Damage
description: Adds flat lightning elemental damage with wide value swings; grants lightning resistance on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Adds flat lightning elemental damage to every attack. Higher per-hit values than fire or cold, no secondary effect on its own. Chain lightning is Static Discharge's job -- this gem just hits hard and fast.
armorFlavorText: Adds lightning resistance. Enemy electrical attacks lose potency. Their arc spells still crackle impressively. They just don't hurt as much.

name: Poison Damage
description: Applies stacking poison DoT on weapons; coats armor in counter-toxins that poison attackers.
weaponFlavorText: DoT that stacks -- multiple poison wounds interact exponentially. Each additional poison amplifies all previous poisons. Layering poison is your game.
armorFlavorText: Your defenses are coated in counter-toxins. Enemies who damage you get poisoned in return by their own attack. They're self-poisoning against you.

name: Shadow Damage
description: Deals damage scaled on enemy current health; reduces enemy accuracy on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Damage scaled on enemy current health -- full health enemies take maximum damage, low health take minimum. You're executing, not farming damage.
armorFlavorText: Shadows confuse incoming attacks and make them less likely to land. Enemy accuracy drops around you. Their perception is unreliable.

name: Chaos Damage
description: Deals highly variable damage that bypasses defenses unpredictably; shifts armor defenses to confuse attackers.
weaponFlavorText: Highly variable damage with unpredictable scaling. Each strike's power is different -- impossible to predict or prepare for. Your damage is chaotic by design.
armorFlavorText: Your defenses shift unpredictably. Incoming attacks hit something different each time. Enemies can't learn your patterns because you don't have one.

name: Critical Strike Chance
description: Increases critical strike chance on weapons; improves defensive positioning to avoid incoming crits on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Your strikes find weak points with supernatural accuracy. Every blow is searching for that perfect angle, that critical vulnerability. You're never wasting energy on inefficient attacks.
armorFlavorText: Your defensive positioning is surgical. You know exactly where incoming attacks are coming from before they arrive. You're not standing in front of the sword -- you're standing beside it.

name: Critical Strike Multiplier
description: Boosts critical strike damage on weapons; converts incoming crit momentum into counterforce on armor.
weaponFlavorText: When you land a critical strike, it explodes with devastating force. Your critical hits don't just hurt -- they devastate. Massive multiplier on already dangerous blows.
armorFlavorText: Your defensive stance converts attack momentum into counterforce. Enemies who hit you experience backlash proportional to their commit. Critical hits against you cause them massive recoil damage.

name: Attack Speed
description: Increases attack speed on weapons; grants evasive speed and dodge chance on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Your movements blur with supernatural speed. You swing faster, strike more often, attack before enemies can react. By the time they perceive the danger, you've already hit them twice.
armorFlavorText: You move with impossible grace and speed. Incoming attacks meet empty space. You're already somewhere else when the blow arrives. Speed is your ultimate defense.

name: Armor Penetration
description: Shreds through enemy armor on weapons; resists penetration effects on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Your attacks shred through enemy defenses like paper. Their armor, shields, resistances -- all irrelevant. You hit them through their protections. Defenses become meaningless.
armorFlavorText: Enemy armor becomes a liability. The stronger their defenses, the harder you punish them for trying. Their protection collapses when you're near. They built that fortress and you're the siege engine.

name: Elemental Penetration
description: Bypasses enemy elemental resistances on weapons; boosts all elemental resistances on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Bypasses elemental resistances with surgical precision. Fire-resistant? Irrelevant. They burn anyway. You ignore their resistances entirely -- magic protections simply don't apply.
armorFlavorText: Your resistances punch through enemy magical protections. You're resistant to fire and you resist their fire-resistance buffs. Double-negating enemy magical advantages.

name: Flat HP
description: Increases maximum health on both weapons and armor, extending fight endurance.
weaponFlavorText: A larger health pool means you can sustain longer fights and deal more cumulative damage. You're built for marathons, not sprints.
armorFlavorText: Raw maximum health. More hit points means enemies have to hit you more times to win. It's straightforward -- you absorb punishment through sheer capacity.

name: Armor
description: Reduces incoming physical damage as a flat percentage on armor; no weapon effect.
armorFlavorText: Reduces incoming physical damage as a flat percentage. Enemies swing. You shrug. The number goes down. That's the whole thing, and it's perfectly effective.

name: Block Chance
description: Grants a chance to physically block attacks on armor; adds block-break to bypass enemy blocks on weapons.
weaponFlavorText: Your strikes can physically parry and redirect incoming danger, turning defense into counterattack. You're not dodging -- you're hitting back.
armorFlavorText: You actively block attacks with physical barriers, negating damage entirely. Blocks are complete protection -- incoming damage just stops at your shield.

name: Dodge Chance
description: Grants a chance to completely evade incoming attacks on armor; no weapon effect.
armorFlavorText: You're not there when the attack lands. Probability warps around you -- incoming strikes just whiff. You're a ghost until you need to be solid.

name: Barrier
description: Generates temporary shield layers on hit with weapons; provides an absorb shield on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Successful strikes generate temporary shield layers that absorb overflow damage. You're building protection as you attack.
armorFlavorText: Temporary shields that regenerate regularly. Incoming damage hits shields first, health second. You're perpetually overshielded.

name: HP Regeneration
description: Grants life on hit for weapons; adds constant passive health regeneration on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Passive health recovery ticks constantly, keeping you in combat longer. The fight duration is your advantage -- eventually, their damage output can't out-pace your healing.
armorFlavorText: Constant passive regeneration that ticks even while standing still. You repair damage automatically. Long wars are won through attrition.

name: Damage Reduction
description: Provides flat percentage reduction to all incoming damage on armor; no weapon effect.
armorFlavorText: Hard cap on incoming damage. Every hit deals less damage, period. Simple math -- enemies face a ceiling on how much they can possibly hurt you. No matter how strong they are.

name: Fortify
description: Grants permanent magical armor enhancement on armor; no weapon effect.
armorFlavorText: Permanent magical armor enhancement. Your basic durability is increased at all times. Attacks just bounce off more often naturally.

name: Lifesteal
description: Heals for a percentage of damage dealt on weapons; recovers health from damage taken on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Every point of damage you deal instantly becomes health restored. High damage means high healing. You're a vampire -- combat sustains you.
armorFlavorText: Enemy attacks feed you. They damage you, they heal you. Extended melee becomes unwinnable for them because they're healing their opponent.

name: Thorns
description: Reflects damage to enemies on hit with weapons; reflects damage back to attackers when hit on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Your attacks are jagged and dangerous. Enemies hurt themselves trying to touch you. Self-defense through sharp edges.
armorFlavorText: Your armor is covered in enchanted spikes. Enemy melee becomes hazardous. They're attacking a cactus. It doesn't end well for them.

name: Life on Kill
description: Restores massive health on finishing blows from weapons; transfers nearby dead enemy health on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Finishing blows restore massive health in one burst. Kills equal instant full heal. You're incentivized to go for executions, not just wear enemies down.
armorFlavorText: Dead enemies nearby transfer remaining health to you. The battlefield becomes a corpse-powered healing field. Multi-kill scenarios become impossible to stop.

name: Movement/Initiative
description: Grants first-strike advantage on weapons; perceives incoming threats before they land on armor.
weaponFlavorText: You act first in combat sequences. You get the first strike before enemies can react. Speed advantage equals strategic advantage.
armorFlavorText: You perceive incoming threats before they land. You're already moving to defend before the attack even commits. Reaction time is supernatural.

name: DOT Multiplier
description: Amplifies all damage-over-time effects on weapons; reduces incoming DoT damage on armor.
weaponFlavorText: All damage-over-time effects you apply are amplified. More damage per tick, longer duration, stacking higher. Persistent damage becomes your primary damage source.
armorFlavorText: DoT effects targeting you are reduced. Poison loses potency. Fire burns less hot. Bleed ticks lighter. Persistent damage is your weakness mitigated.

name: Stun Chance
description: Adds a chance to stun and interrupt enemies on weapons; grants stun resistance on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Chance to interrupt and disable enemies entirely. Stunned enemies can't act, can't dodge, can't retaliate. Complete control.
armorFlavorText: When enemies attack, they have a chance to stun themselves. Their own aggression backfires. Their attack fails and they stand helpless.

name: Slow on Hit
description: Saps enemy momentum on weapon hits; grants slow resistance on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Your strikes sap enemy momentum. Movement speed drops dramatically with each hit. Chasers become statues. Fleers can't escape. Movement becomes impossible.
armorFlavorText: Attackers slow down after hitting you. Their combat momentum dies. They become sluggish against you. Time becomes your ally.

name: Chance on Hit
description: Triggers bonus proc damage when landing hits on weapons; activates passive defensive magic on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Passive magical blessing on every attack. The more you swing, the more procs you generate. Raw hit count equals magic generation.
armorFlavorText: Combat proximity triggers passive defensive magic. Just standing near attackers activates your safeguards. Your aura defends you.

name: Chance on Taking Damage
description: Triggers a healing proc when taking damage; pain fuels retaliation on weapons and strengthens defenses on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Pain fuels your retaliation. Every hit you take triggers counteroffense. You get stronger the more you bleed.
armorFlavorText: Damage taken activates defenses that strengthen you. Taking punishment makes you tougher. Enemies literally power your defenses by attacking you.

name: Chance on Critical Strike
description: Procs bonus damage on critical strikes from weapons; procs counterattack damage when enemies crit you on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Procs bonus damage on critical strikes -- smaller amounts than the armor version, but attached to your strongest hits. Crit-heavy builds double-dip: more crits means more procs.
armorFlavorText: Procs bonus damage when enemies crit you -- and at higher values than the weapon version. Enemies landing their biggest hits are accidentally triggering your counterattack. Their risk is your reward.

name: Chance on Block
description: Triggers offensive magic on successful blocks from weapons; activates healing on blocks from armor.
weaponFlavorText: Successfully blocking doesn't just stop damage -- it triggers offensive magic. Defense becomes your offense vector.
armorFlavorText: Every successful block automatically activates magical effects. Blocking is now your most dangerous action, not your most defensive one.

name: Chance on Kill
description: Triggers jackpot healing effects on finishing blows; dead enemies feed your defenses on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Finishing blows trigger jackpot effects beyond just winning. Kill count equals magic generation. Massacre equals power surge.
armorFlavorText: Enemies dying near you feed your defenses. The battlefield sustains you. Dead enemies become your shield.

name: Chance on Low HP
description: Unlocks desperation power with damage multipliers on weapons; surges defenses near death on armor.
weaponFlavorText: Desperation unlocks power. When you're near death, special effects activate. Low HP means high damage multiplier.
armorFlavorText: When close to death, defenses surge. The more desperate you are, the harder you are to kill. You're practically invulnerable at 1 HP.
